eldonia.reason_and_scope: The full soft discoidal organism reads as an intact radial animal. The dorsal internal-gut cue is flush and described as a teaching projection, not an external hose or natural coloration. Supplemental ventral bottom views show the paired dendritic oral tentacles and separate off-centre openings, correcting the raw generated concept’s dorsal-anus mistake in the frozen written representation. This is fit for the intended educational prop, not a species-level specimen reconstruction. Caveats: body thickness/posture/color/fine branching are inferred; affinity/ecology remain uncertain; underside anatomy is not conveyed by the fixed eight views alone.
